name: dreaming
description: Consolidates Claude Code native auto memory. A SessionStart hook decides when a pass is due and has the main session start a visible dreaming:dreamer subagent, which writes a proposal and a report to a staging directory. The dreaming:dream skill shows the diff, snapshots memory in git and applies it only on approval, and a PreToolUse hook confines the subagent to staging. Requires jq.
